name: Dhanbad
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Dhanbad District Administration explicitly offers land-record services through Jharbhoomi and locates the service at the DC Office in Dhanbad. The official DILRMP map-digitization report identifies Dhanbad district cadastral-map and parcel processing; this does not establish full geometry at the population settlement locator.

source.name: Jharbhoomi / JharBhuNaksha public land-record and cadastral mapping portals
source.operator: Department of Revenue, Registration and Land Reforms, Government of Jharkhand / NIC

queries.query: Dhanbad official cadastral parcel map Jharbhu Naksha public land records
queries.executionMethod: Executed English web search; official district land-record page opened and directly retrieved; linked state portal requested.
queries.result: The official city-district service directs users to the state land-record portal. DILRMP documents Dhanbad cadastral processing, but no native public polygon response was retrieved.

queries.query: धनबाद भू नक्शा झारखण्ड जमीन नक्शा जारभू नक्शा आधिकारिक
queries.executionMethod: Executed separate Hindi web search and reviewed official district/state mapping leads.
queries.result: Official Dhanbad and state land-record service leads found; linked state hosts did not respond to direct verified-TLS requests in this environment.

queries.executionMethod: Executed follow-up official-host search to identify the mapping portal independently of the textual land-record service.
queries.result: Official DILRMP and NIC materials publish https://jharbhunaksha.jharkhand.gov.in/ as the cadastral map portal. Its direct public home request also failed connection timeout, so no viewer bootstrap, layer schema or georeferenced parcel could be inspected.

webFetchAttempts.result: Indexed historic service describes citizen plot-map viewing/download. Current web open redirects to general India services page, so the old detail page is not asserted to remain live.

freshResearch.unqualifiedLead: A third-party offline viewer describes hierarchy and extent APIs for the official WMS. It is an implementation lead only; its hierarchy, extents and raster renderings were not treated as full cadastral parcel geometry or city coverage.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Dhanbad land-record administration and Jharkhand cadastral map services.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official district land-service information retrieved; state textual and cadastral map hosts timed out before a response. No parcel feature or point-scope geometry was returned.

technicalBlocker: The district landing page was reachable, but direct verified-TLS requests to the linked Jharbhoomi and separately documented JharBhuNaksha portal timed out before an HTTP response. Public parcel geometry protocol and coordinate reference could not be checked.
remainingUncertainty: Availability of complete georeferenced urban parcel polygons at the Dhanbad WUP locator remains unverified; district cadastral-processing figures do not prove point coverage.
nextStep: When the documented cadastral viewer is reachable, inspect its actual public selector, extent and feature routes, resolve the selected local map coordinate reference, and retrieve bounded full polygons without substituting a raster or extent rectangle.
